source_lineage.excerpt:
PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  With the fix the device will now log the actual HTTP response
   code received if there is an error.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  Affected users are those who call the urlopen to send a HTTP
   HEAD request in GatewayScript actions, and then try to read the
   non-empty response using the readAsBuffer, readAsBuffers, or
   readAsJSON methods.  The readAsXXX calls might hang until the
   connection times out.

*  Fix is available in 7.0.0.5 and 7.1.0.3.
   
   For a list of the latest fix packs available, please see:
   http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631]
   
   
    
   
   

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

* IBM DataPower Gateway V7.1 Announcement [http://www-01.ibm.com/common/ssi/ShowDoc.wss?docURL=/common/ssi/rep_ca/4/897/ENUS214-394/index.html&lang=en&request_locale=en] 
 * IBM Knowledge Center: IBM DataPower Gateway V7.1 documentation [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SS9H2Y_7.1.0/com.ibm.dp.doc/releasenotes.html?lang=en]

Refer to the Fix Packs [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24038524] for details on the Authorized Program Analysis Reports (APARs) included in this firmware version. See also:  *  [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg24014405]Link to the Fix Central site [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/]to begin the download process. 
 * New to Fix Central? If so, see Fix download method for IBM DataPower Gateway. 
 * IBM DataPower SOA Appliances Support Lifecycle [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21246298] for reference

* WebSphere DataPower firmware V6.0 announcement [http://www-01.ibm.com/common/ssi/cgi-bin/ssialias?infotype=AN&subtype=CA&htmlfid=897/ENUS213-172&appname=USN] 

Refer to the Release Notes [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27038952] for details on the Authorized Program Analysis Reports (APARs) included in this version. See also:  *  [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg24014405]Link to the Fix Central site [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/]to begin the download process. 
 * New to Fix Central? If so, see Fix download method for WebSphere DataPower SOA Appliances. [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21376557] 
 * IBM WebSphere DataPower Appliance Support Lifecycle [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21246298] for reference
